doc: A degenerate window a == b = 0.5 (a division by zero, no call site of the generator uses it): (x - a) / 0 is -inf below the edge (clipped to 0), +inf above it (clipped to 1) and 0 / 0 = NaN exactly ON it, which np.clip keeps as NaN, so the output is NaN there (and the Hermite polynomial of NaN is NaN). Float64 x with a python-float window; numpy warnings suppressed. NaN equals NaN in the comparison; documents what the oracle does, a port must not guard the division. Every value is exactly 0, 1 or NaN, so the comparison is exact (a nudge of a or b would make the window finite, which is not this case).
